scripts.turn-on: open -a Docker && echo 'Starting Docker Desktop, please wait...' && until docker info > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && docker compose up -d && (cd apps/api && npx prisma db push && npm run dev &) && (cd apps/web && npm run dev)
scripts.turn-off: (docker compose stop 2>/dev/null || true) && (lsof -ti:3000,5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true) && (osascript -e 'quit app "Docker"' 2>/dev/null || true) && echo '✅ Everything has been stopped and Docker Desktop quit successfully.'
